failure_summary.description: The agents gave multiple synonymous labels or expanded a concise name instead of returning one minimal answer.
The agent answered with the conference title rather than the requested city, failing to match the answer to the clue's slot.

patch.reasoning: The skill already directs agents to give the shortest unambiguous answer, omit unnecessary name parts, and verify that the candidate fits the requested type. These failures reflect nonadherence to existing guidance, so adding similar rules would be duplicative.
